after_start.name: {name}
after_start.text: *After school. I figure I'll look around campus a bit. I still don't know the layout. Walking down the hallway. My phone buzzes. — The group chat from my old school.*

after_kakao_1.name: {name}
after_kakao_1.text: *'yo sojeong's doing fine at her new school~' 'oh thank god lol' — I slip the phone back into my pocket.*

after_kakao_3.name: {name}
after_kakao_3.text: *I look at the last message again — 'Thank goodness lol.' I open the reply field, type nothing, and turn off the screen.*

after_kakao_5.name: {name}
after_kakao_5.text: *The reply box stays empty. My thumb stops once beside the send button.*

after_kakao_end.name: {name}
after_kakao_end.text: *I take out my phone again and leave the group chat. At the top of the chat list, only the new school's messenger remains.*

after1_jealousy_seo_1.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_1.text: Hey, where'd you go during lunch? I went to the school store but you weren't there.

after1_jealousy_seo_2.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_seo_2.text: *I type 'with Seoyeon' in the reply box, then delete it. The cursor blinks alone in the first space again.*

after1_jealousy_seo_3.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_3.text: ...The rooftop? Just the two of you?

after1_jealousy_seo_choice.name: Dain
choices: I ate on the rooftop with the president. (Honest)
I was just wandering around alone. (Lie)

after1_jealousy_seo_honest.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_seo_honest.text: Yeah, she brought me there. Even had a packed lunch for two.

after1_jealousy_seo_lie.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_seo_lie.text: Nah, I was just wandering around by myself.

after1_jealousy_seo_lie_2.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_seo_lie_2.text: Really? Alone? — Well, makes sense, it's your first day!

after1_jealousy_seo_yuna.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_seo_yuna.text: *A folded note is tucked in the bag's side pocket. Yuna's handwriting. 'I saw you at lunch on the rooftop. ...You two looked close.' Three dots are pressed into the bottom of the paper.*

after1_jealousy_dain_1.name: Seoyeon
after1_jealousy_dain_1.text: I saw you at the school store with Dain during lunch. You adapt fast.

after1_jealousy_dain_2.name: {name}
after1_jealousy_dain_2.text: *She's smiling. Her fingers tap the clipboard. I look down at the blank reply box.*

after1_jealousy_yuna_1.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_yuna_1.text: You went to the library at lunch? With Yuna?

after1_jealousy_yuna_2.name: Dain
after1_jealousy_yuna_2.text: ...She doesn't usually hang out with anyone, you know.

after_miss_dain_1.name: {name}
after_miss_dain_1.text: *Walking down the hallway when I hear heavy footsteps behind me.*

after_miss_dain_3.name: {name}
after_miss_dain_3.text: *I dodge to the side reflexively. Dain zooms past me. Running, then a sudden stop.*

after_miss_dain_5.name: {name}
after_miss_dain_5.text: Why are you sprinting in the hallway?

after_miss_dain_6.name: Dain
after_miss_dain_6.text: Late! Gotta hit the gym! — Catch you tomorrow, transfer kid!

after_miss_dain_6_b.name: {name}
after_miss_dain_6_b.text: *Wave your hands and run. When stopping suddenly, grab your right knee and immediately release your hand.*

after_miss_dain_7.name: {name}
after_miss_dain_7.text: *She runs off waving. The name the teacher called earlier — Dain. Already talking to me casually.*

after_miss_yuna_1.name: {name}
after_miss_yuna_1.text: *Passing the library entrance, I see a girl with red eyes walking while reading. Her tattooed arm carefully supports the spine of the book.*

after_miss_yuna_1_c.name: {name}
after_miss_yuna_1_c.text: *I pick it up and hold it out. Yuna stops and takes the bookmark.*

after_miss_yuna_2.name: Yuna
after_miss_yuna_2.text: *She spreads the corner of the bookmark with her thumb and holds it up to the light. No crease.*

after_miss_yuna_4.name: {name}
after_miss_yuna_4.text: *And then walks again. Only the thumb touching the corner of the bookmark is visible.*

after_miss_seoyeon_1.name: {name}
after_miss_seoyeon_1.text: *On my way out, I run into Seoyeon in the hallway.*

after_miss_seoyeon_4.name: Seoyeon
after_miss_seoyeon_4.text: Left the rooftop open and you didn't show. — Got some nerve, transfer.

after_miss_seoyeon_6.name: Seoyeon
after_miss_seoyeon_6.text: ...I just went up for air. The door happened to be open.

after_miss_seoyeon_7.name: {name}
after_miss_seoyeon_7.text: *My name is still at the top of Seoyeon's clipboard. The checkbox next to it is still empty.*

after_hidden_homeroom_1.name: {name}
after_hidden_homeroom_1.text: *I'm about to leave when I stop in my tracks. I keep thinking about the homeroom teacher — the way she watched everyone until the very end. I find myself standing in front of the faculty office. I knock and push the door open.*

after_hidden_homeroom_3.name: {name}
after_hidden_homeroom_3.text: *It's the homeroom teacher. One sleeve of her cardigan is folded up, and a creased notice sticks out between the pages of the attendance book.*

after_hidden_homeroom_3_b.name: {name}
after_hidden_homeroom_3_b.text: What you said earlier — it won't leave my head.

after_hidden_homeroom_3_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_hidden_homeroom_3_c.text: Oh. So that's what this is about? — Glad you came. Sit for a minute.

after_hidden_homeroom_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_hidden_homeroom_4.text: You're not in trouble. — Just checking in on the new kid. How's it going so far?

after_hidden_homeroom_choice.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_hidden_homeroom_choice.text: *The homeroom teacher lowers the clipboard and looks at {name}'s face.*
choices: I'm okay. It's a better school than I expected.

after_homeroom_ok.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_ok.text: Yeah? — If anything comes up, swing by the office. Paperwork's a good excuse.

after_homeroom_ok_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_ok_b.text: *The teacher pushes the papers on the desk to one side. She rests her hand on the back of the chair and pauses to choose her words.*

after_homeroom_ok_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_ok_3.text: Better than expected, huh. — Weirdly reassuring to hear.

after_homeroom_ok_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_ok_4.text: *The homeroom teacher looks down at the documents, but the end of the clipboard no longer moves.*

after_homeroom_ok_5.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_ok_5.text: Being perfect on day one will burn you out. Take it easy. — Now get going.

after_homeroom_ok_6.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_ok_6.text: *The homeroom teacher turns to the desk again. Say hello briefly and close the office door. The story of vending machine juice lingers in my ears.*

after_homeroom_honest_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_1.text: Being overwhelmed is normal. Day-one calm would be the weirder thing.

after_homeroom_honest_2.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_2.text: Did you ever switch schools yourself?

after_homeroom_honest_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_3.text: ...Something like that. I've been thrown into a new place without any warning.

after_homeroom_honest_3_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_3_b.text: *Something similar? The teacher's hand briefly hides behind the clipboard.*

after_homeroom_honest_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_4.text: If it gets rough, swing by the office. I'll treat you to a coffee — wait, you're a student. Juice, then.

after_homeroom_honest_5.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_5.text: A teacher buying drinks for a student?

after_homeroom_honest_6_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_6_b.text: *The teacher only looks at the corner of the attendance book.*

after_homeroom_honest_choice2.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_choice2.text: *The corner of the attendance book rests against the desk.*
choices: If you're worried, you can just say so.
I'll hold you to that juice.

after_homeroom_honest_choice2a_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_choice2a_b.text: *The teacher presses the corner of the attendance book once.*

after_homeroom_honest_choice2b.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_choice2b.text: *A small laugh.* Don't get your hopes up. It's from the vending machine.

after_homeroom_honest_choice2b_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_choice2b_b.text: *The homeroom teacher closes the attendance book. After reaching the threshold, she calls {name} again.*

after_homeroom_honest_9.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_9.text: If you can't settle in, I'll come drag you back myself.

after_homeroom_honest_9_b.name: {name}
after_homeroom_honest_9_b.text: *From the end of the hall, the attendance book closes with a small sound.*

after_homeroom_honest_10.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_honest_10.text: *The teacher disappears down the end of the hallway. Her long hair sways, and the edge of the attendance book sticks out from inside her arms.*

after_homeroom_freetalk.name: Homeroom Teacher
after_homeroom_freetalk.text: *Chatting with the homeroom teacher in the hallway.*
after_homeroom_freetalk.context: Day 1 after school. The homeroom teacher stopped the transfer student to check on them. The student was honest about feeling overwhelmed. Tone: light and cautious because it is still the first day. Do not bring up heavy backstory. Keep it to banter and short exchanges.
after_homeroom_freetalk.personality: The homeroom teacher hides warmth behind dry humor and deadpan delivery. Late 20s female teacher with brown wavy long hair and beige cardigan. She wraps her feelings in words like "work" and "professional concern." Former aspiring novelist.

after_hidden_nurse_intro.name: {name}
after_hidden_nurse_intro.text: *I'm walking down the hall when — my head spins slightly. When I lean against the wall, the cool paint touches my palm. I see a 'Nurse's Office' sign down the corridor.*

after_hidden_nurse_choice.name: {name}
after_hidden_nurse_choice.text: *I've been meeting people nonstop since this morning. Taking ten minutes to sit down wouldn't be that dramatic.*

after_hidden_nurse_intro_b.name: {name}
after_hidden_nurse_intro_b.text: *I stop in front of the door and take a breath. Just a short rest. I put my hand on the handle. Cold metal against my palm.*

after_nurse_enter_1.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_1.text: *I open the infirmary door. Antiseptic smell. White curtains and a bed, a small desk. A woman in a white coat looks at me over her glasses. The stethoscope around her neck brushes the edge of the desk and sways slightly.*

after_nurse_enter_4.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_4.text: You're the transfer kid, right? First day and already in the nurse's office. Rough one, huh? Let me see.

after_nurse_enter_4_c.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_4_c.text: Your uniform's brand-new and stiff. Plus that faint starch smell. *Sniff sniff* Oh — cherry blossoms in there too. A romantic transfer student, huh.

after_nurse_enter_4_d.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_4_d.text: *The nurse gets up and comes closer. When the tip of the thermometer touches the back of my hand, my fingers stiffen slightly.*

after_nurse_enter_5.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_5.text: *The nurse walks over. Her hand lands on my forehead.*

after_nurse_enter_6.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_6.text: No fever... could just be low blood pressure.

after_nurse_enter_6_b.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_6_b.text: You can tell blood pressure from a forehead?

after_nurse_enter_7.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_7.text: No fever, but... you need to unclench a bit. Here, lie down. Ten minutes.

after_nurse_enter_7_b.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_7_b.text: *I lie down on the bed. The ceiling is white.*

after_nurse_enter_7_c.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_7_c.text: *Pulling the curtain halfway* Want some water? Or something warm?

after_nurse_enter_choice.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_choice.text: *I lie down on the bed. Through the curtain, I can see the nurse's back.*
choices: You look more tired than I do, honestly.
The nurse's office is quieter than I expected.

after_nurse_enter_choice_a.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_choice_a.text: ...Sharp patient. I'm the one who should be worrying here.

after_nurse_enter_choice_b.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_choice_b.text: Right? I like it here. — It's quiet, and if you ignore the smell of disinfectant, it's perfect.

after_nurse_enter_8.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_8.text: Don't worry about being so polite in here. The nurse's office is a chill zone. That's kind of the whole point.

after_nurse_enter_8_c.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_8_c.text: *Handing over a cup of water* Right, I'm a teacher. But in here, you being comfortable comes first.

after_nurse_enter_8_d.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_8_d.text: *I drink the water and look around the nurse's office. A small potted plant sits in one corner.*

after_nurse_enter_9_c.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_9_c.text: Yeah, rosemary. — I've had it since my hospital days.

after_nurse_enter_9_e.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_9_e.text: *The nurse pauses for a moment. Then smiles.*

after_nurse_enter_10.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_10.text: Old story. I like school. Here, when the bell rings, everyone goes back to their classroom.

after_nurse_enter_10_b.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_10_b.text: *The nurse closes the drawer. A light-green notebook inside is briefly visible, then gone. Ten minutes have passed.*

after_nurse_enter_10_c.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_10_c.text: Thank you. I feel a bit better.

after_nurse_enter_11.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11.text: If you feel dizzy again, come back. Because the health room is always open. Instead, hold back and don’t come late. I might scold you first.

after_nurse_enter_11_c.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_c.text: *Narrowing her eyes* If you're feeling bad and keep pushing through it, of course I'm going to worry. That's literally why I'm here.

after_nurse_enter_11_d.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_d.text: *The nurse sets the water cup on the desk. The bottom of the cup gives a low sound.*

after_nurse_enter_11_e.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_e.text: *The nurse gives a small shrug, and the easy smile slips back into place.*

after_nurse_enter_11_f.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_f.text: What I said earlier — thank you for your concern. I never thought I would hear those words from a patient.

after_nurse_enter_11_g.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_g.text: *The health teacher puts down the water cup and starts laughing.*

after_nurse_enter_11_h.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_h.text: You said it was quiet earlier, right? — I still remember that.

after_nurse_enter_11_i.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_11_i.text: *The nurse folds the edge of the curtain once with her finger.*

after_nurse_enter_11_j.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_11_j.text: *Just as I reach for the nurse's office door, the nurse calls from behind me.*

after_nurse_enter_12.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_enter_12.text: Next time you feel sick — actually, better if there isn't a next time.

after_nurse_enter_12_b.name: {name}
after_nurse_enter_12_b.text: *Smile lightly and wave. Look at the back of your hand with the band on. The smell of disinfectant sticks with you longer than expected.*

after_nurse_freetalk.name: School Nurse
after_nurse_freetalk.text: *She puts away the thermometer and smiles from the back of her chair.* Feeling less dizzy now?
after_nurse_freetalk.context: Day 1 after school. The transfer student felt dizzy and visited the nurse's office. The nurse was playful but attentive. Tone: light and cautious because it is still the first day. Do not bring up heavy backstory. Keep it to banter and short exchanges.
after_nurse_freetalk.personality: The school nurse is playful and teasing, but hides sincerity behind jokes. A former hospital nurse who burned out and moved to the school. She's quick to loosen the atmosphere so students can relax first.

after_nurse_skip.name: {name}
after_nurse_skip.text: *I've wandered around enough today. Let's go home and rest.*
